notes.title: True Bliss 1.04
notes.content:
[h1] True Bliss v 1.04 Release notes: [/h1]

[b] New features: [/b]
[list]
    [*]view move tool: added mapping to right mouse button and WSAD keys
   [*]view rotate tool: added mapping to middle mouse button
   [*]view zoom tool: added mapping to mouse scroll wheel
[/list]

[b] Changes:[/b]
[list]
   [*]changed tutorials to reflect control changes
   [*]simplified win conditions for level 6 to account for steep learning curve
[/list]

[b] Fixes: [/b]
[list]
   [*]stability
   [*]fixed music stopped playing issue
[/list]

Thank you for playing,

notes.title: True Bliss 1.01
notes.content:
True Bliss v 1.01 Release notes:

New features:

- Added the ability to select the level to play in Journey Mode - now you can use < and > brackets to move to the previous and next level, provided the next level was completed and thus unlocked.

- Added tutorial section explaining the difference between primary and secondary pointer and the importance of start zones (level 5)

Changes:
- view move tool: sensitivity decreased 5 times
- view move tool: switched left side with right side
- decreased the scaling of text inside in-game tutorial animations
- changed texts of several in-game tutorials
- improved the placement of the in-game tutorial texts
- decreased the conditions required to win level 14th to make life easier

Fixes:
- transform reset tool: fixed reset of scene scale

Thank you for playing,
Artur Mandas
